variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian at the inn, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Hello traveler. You know you're tracking mud all over my floor.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: I hear the wolves are bold this year. Good for business, friend!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Strangers aren't usually welcome in my shop. But for a little extra gold, I'll overlook it this once.

variants.specifics: Krennack: Tobbs of the Broken Pick inn, Hurlo the smith, Zilva the cross old witch of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Tobbs
inn.text: You look like you've been down the shafts too long, friend.

arms.speaker: Hurlo
arms.text: Are you a new hire for the mines?

magic.speaker: Zilva
magic.text: Word gets around. Get out, before I hex the beard off your chin!

variants.specifics: Skell: Oggin of the Muddy Mug inn, Krell the smith at Krell's Forge, Mother Hesk of the potion shop.

inn.speaker: Oggin
inn.text: Welcome, welcome! I smell my favorite smell -- a stranger with a full purse.

arms.speaker: Krell
arms.text: This is Krell's Forge. I doubt you'll find much here worth your gold, stranger.

magic.speaker: Mother Hesk
magic.text: The damp has gotten into every scroll in my shop.

variants.specifics: Varrok: Tibbet keeps the inn, Brask the forge, Quillon the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Tibbet
inn.text: Maybe you'd like a hot supper, or a bed for the night?

arms.speaker: Brask
arms.text: What brings you to my forge, stranger? I've no time to waste.

magic.speaker: Quillon
magic.text: I just know we're going to be wonderful friends! Assuming, of course, you spend lots of gold here!

variants.specifics: Kesk: Selka keeps the inn, Ostwin the smith sells arms, Pellik sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Selka
inn.text: I trust you'll be wanting a bed before dark, kind sir. Nobody in Kesk sleeps out of doors with the dead walking about.

arms.speaker: Ostwin
arms.text: Sorry, I don't sell swords to fishermen.

magic.speaker: Pellik
magic.text: The dead came up out of the lake again. Need a potion?

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Mossop keeps the Inkpot inn, Dorgle sells arms to a town of wizards, Yselda sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Mossop
inn.text: Traveler, eh? You'd better turn around while you can. No doubt Malgrin's Ogres will come knocking here soon, too! Strange days we're living in, isn't it?

arms.speaker: Dorgle
arms.text:
Stranger, eh? Most of these wizards turn up their noses at good steel, but not one of them ever swung a sword in a real fight and I have! What do those bookworms know!? Hm? Heh, heh, heh...

You can shop here anytime, friend.

magic.speaker: Yselda
magic.text: I hear Malgrin's Ogres are already at the edge of the fen. Maybe it's time I packed up my potions and moved north.

variants.specifics: Ulmgard: Bodo of the Cold Kettle inn, Gorm the smith, Yorla the potion seller.

arms.speaker: Gorm
arms.text: Hard times, lad. I can't believe the Undead got as far as the Upper Gate. A black day indeed! Best buy what you need while I've still got it!

magic.speaker: Yorla
magic.text: Sorry, stranger, but my shelves are looking a bit bare. Cold weather makes folks drink up every potion in sight. Heh, heh, heh...

variants.specifics: Kalgarr: Bulba keeps the tavern, Hobb sells arms and armor, Zibbet hawks potions.

arms.speaker: Hobb
arms.text: Hmm... Perhaps not the sharpest blades... But sturdy enough all the same!

magic.speaker: Zibbet
magic.text: Pssst! Hey! Stranger! Want a potion? Cheapest in town and they're brewed right over the lava of Kalgarr!

variants.specifics: Torvel: Bertol keeps the Crooked Crown inn, Hargo the smithy, Quenna sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Bertol
inn.text: So, now you've met both Brask at the gate and our Mayor. Welcome to the Crooked Crown, young sir!

arms.speaker: Hargo
arms.text: You'd better choose quick the bandits took my last load of iron.

magic.speaker: Quenna
magic.text: Wanna buy a potion? They're carried up from the deep mushroom caves of Grelloch.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Durnhal: Hammet of the Fat Turnip inn, Krell the smith, Ombra who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Hammet
inn.text: You're the curious one to be poking around Durnhal at harvest time.

arms.speaker: Krell
arms.text: Business is a bit dead this week, with the cabbage harvest and all.

magic.speaker: Ombra
magic.text: Haven't had many customers lately. Durnhal isn't exactly a merry place these days, what with Ogres tramping through the cornfields.
